info.title: clink
info.description: A CLI tool for links manipulation. The reusable library API ships separately as the Foundation.Data.Doublets.Cli NuGet package.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: LiNo CLI Tool for managing links data store

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the links database file [default: db.links]

options.name: --query
options.description: LiNo query for CRUD operation

options.name: --trace
options.description: Enable trace (verbose output), including each transport event of --serve, --connect and --forward (as CLINK_IPC_TRACE=1 does) [default: False]

options.name: --auto-create-missing-references
options.description: Create missing numeric and named references as self-referential point links [default: False]

options.name: --structure
options.description: ID of the link to format its structure

options.name: --before
options.description: Print the state of the database before applying changes [default: False]

options.name: --changes
options.description: Print the changes applied by the query [default: False]

options.name: --after
options.description: Print the state of the database after applying changes [default: False]

options.name: --always
options.description: Store the query as an always-on persistent transformation trigger [default: False]

options.name: --once
options.description: Store the query as a persistent transformation trigger that deletes itself after it fires [default: False]

options.name: --never
options.description: Remove stored persistent transformation triggers matching the query [default: False]

options.name: --triggers
options.description: Enable persistent transformation triggers for this command [default: False]

options.name: --triggers-file
options.description: Path to the persistent transformation trigger links database

options.name: --embed-triggers
options.description: Store persistent transformation triggers directly in the main links database [default: False]

options.name: --in
options.description: Path to read and import a LiNo file into the database

options.name: --out
options.description: Path to write the complete database as a LiNo file

options.name: --import-binary
options.description: Path to read and import a store archive in binary links notation

options.name: --export-binary
options.description: Path to write the complete database, names included, as a store archive in binary links notation

options.name: --transactions
options.description: Enable the transactions layer (default log path: <db>.transitions.log) [default: False]

options.name: --transactions-file
options.description: Path to the transitions log store (default: <db>.transitions.log). Implies --transactions.

options.name: --commit-mode
options.description: Choose 'sync' or 'async' commits (default: sync). Implies --transactions.

options.name: --retention
options.description: Log retention policy: 'infinite', 'sized:<n>', or 'chunked:<n>:<dir>'. Implies --transactions.

options.name: --vc
options.description: Enable the version-control decorator (implies --transactions) [default: False]

options.name: --vc-file
options.description: Path to the version-control branches store (default: <db>.versioncontrol.links)

options.name: --branch
options.description: Switch to a branch (creating it if --branch-from is also passed). Implies --vc.

options.name: --branch-from
options.description: When creating a branch with --branch, fork from this sequence point.

options.name: --checkout
options.description: Time-travel to a specific transition sequence or named tag. Implies --vc.

options.name: --tag
options.description: Create a tag as 'name' (current head) or 'name=<sequence-or-tag>'. Uses the first '=' whose suffix resolves. Implies --vc.

options.name: --list-branches
options.description: List version-control branches and exit. [default: False]

options.name: --list-tags
options.description: List version-control tags and exit. [default: False]

options.name: --log
options.description: Print the transitions log and exit. Implies --transactions. [default: False]

options.name: --serve
options.description: Serve the database on an endpoint until stopped: a TCP address (e.g. 127.0.0.1:7878, port 0 picks a free port) or KIND:ADDRESS for another transport, such as unix:/tmp/links.sock, pipe:NAME, fifo:DIR, shm:DIR, mmap:DIR, file:DIR, signal:DIR, mq:DIR, sysvmq:DIR, udp:HOST:PORT, stdio, mailslot:DIR, copydata:DIR or alpc:DIR (see docs/protocol/ipc-transports-v1.md); repeat it to serve one store on several endpoints at once. Each message may use the text or the binary LiNo protocol

options.name: --forward
options.description: With --serve: relay every connection, byte for byte, to this endpoint instead of serving a database (stacks transports)

options.name: --connect
options.description: Send the query to a clink server on a --serve endpoint (e.g. 127.0.0.1:7878 or shm:/tmp/links) instead of opening a database; an empty query reads every link

options.name: --protocol
options.description: Wire protocol: 'text' or 'binary' with --connect (default: text), 'any', 'text' or 'binary' with --serve (default: any)

options.name: --external-references
options.description: Binary protocol: send numbers as external references (implies --protocol binary) [default: False]

options.name: --arity
options.description: Binary protocol: link lengths to use, 'n', 'min..max' or 'min..' (default: 2, doublets only; e.g. 2..3 adds triplets, 1.. any length; implies --protocol binary)

options.name: --packed-widths
options.description: Binary protocol: give each section of links the narrowest reference width it needs instead of one width for the whole packet (implies --protocol binary) [default: False]

options.name: --graphql
options.description: With --serve: serve Hasura-compatible GraphQL for Deep over HTTP and WebSocket instead of the links protocol [default: False]

options.name: --jwt-secret
options.description: With --graphql: the HS256 secret of tokens; without it a random one lasts as long as the process

options.name: --graphql-admin-secret
options.description: With --graphql: the value of x-hasura-admin-secret that bypasses permissions

options.name: --deep-package
options.description: With --graphql: a JSON file of rows {id, type_id, from_id, to_id, string?, number?, object?} to load when starting; may be repeated

options.name: --lock
options.description: How concurrent invocations on one store are serialized: 'flock' (default; an OS lock on <db>.lock, released when the holder exits), 'pid' (the directory <db>.lock.d, broken once its owner process is gone) or 'none'. Writers lock exclusively, read-only runs share it

options.name: --no-lock
options.description: Same as --lock none, for callers that serialize access themselves [default: False]

options.name: --lock-timeout
options.description: How long to wait for a locked store before failing with the name of its owner, in milliseconds (default: 30000; 0 fails at once)

options.name: --lock-status
options.description: Print who holds the locks of the store, then exit [default: False]

options.name: --triplets
options.description: With --serve: read every request as triplets, (create: (type from to)), (each: (index type from to)) and three-part substitutions, over this store of doublets; without it, every request is about doublets [default: False]

options.name: --permissions
options.description: Check every read and write against permission rules stored as links: 'self' (rules in the data) or a links file of rules; without it, nothing is checked

options.name: --subject
options.description: The subject (a link index or name) queries run as with --permissions, and the subject of --serve connections before (auth: token) (default: 0, a guest)

options.name: --tokens
options.description: The token table of (auth: token) for --serve, --grant-token and --revoke-token: 'self' (tokens in the data) or a links file

options.name: --grant-token
options.description: Let a token authenticate as --subject in the --tokens table, then exit

options.name: --revoke-token
options.description: Forget a token of the --tokens table, then exit

options.name: --token
options.description: With --connect: authenticate with (auth: token) before sending the query
